name: bookleaf-author-support-portal
description: Full-stack MERN Author Support & Communication Portal for BookLeaf Publishing

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,magenta" "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run start --prefix client"

author: BookLeaf Engineering
